controlPlaneUsdPerHour.source: Managed Kubernetes control-plane fee (EKS-style). Assumption; not verified.

loadBalancerUsdPerHour.source: ALB base hourly charge (LCU charges excluded). Assumption; not verified.

paymentUsdPerSession.source: Assumption for x402 settlement (L2 gas + facilitator). Mainnet fees vary; mock mode has zero on-chain cost.

scheduling.note: Kubernetes schedules on requests; this model uses the same requests the controller sets: cpu/4 (min 50m), memory/4 (min 64Mi). It also reports a conservative capacity bounded by limits (no memory overcommit).
